prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 电子发票常见问题 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 3 columns × 7 rows. Row headers: yes (first logical column identifies each row).
Per-column content facts (content px at 13px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "问题" · longest unbreakable word 27px · one-line width 253px
  col 2: header "回答" · longest unbreakable word 27px · one-line width 1248px
  col 3: header "相关链接" · longest unbreakable word 175px · one-line width 190px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 538px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 537px.
Fixed: content, font, 13px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"帮助读者查找电子发票的常见问题，并阅读对应的解答和相关链接。","reading":"读者先扫描首列问题，找到所需主题后横向阅读回答，再按需使用同一行的链接；回答较长，预计会决定多数行的高度，问题和链接可在这些行高中适度换行。","groups":["问题与回答构成每行的问答对，应通过同一行的对齐关系保持关联。","相关链接是各问题的补充入口，与同一行的问答关联，但承担导航而非解释作用。"],"keep_intact":["相关链接中最长的连续字符串，至少需要175px文字宽度。","问题和回答中的连续词语及标识符应保持完整。"],"may_wrap":["问题可按中文自然断行，但应保持易于逐行扫描。","回答可按中文自然断行；长回答会形成较高的行。","链接文字中允许断行的部分可换行。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r1A: widths [125, 225, 187] · table 538×857px · row heights [33, 134, 134, 134, 134, 154, 134] · column headers wrapped 0/3 · tallest cell 7 lines · mid-word splits 4
Design r1B: widths [115, 226, 196] · table 538×857px · row heights [33, 134, 134, 134, 134, 154, 134] · column headers wrapped 0/3 · tallest cell 7 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r1C: widths [115, 209, 213] · table 538×898px · row heights [33, 154, 134, 134, 154, 154, 134] · column headers wrapped 0/3 · tallest cell 7 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r1A","good":"问题列较宽，粗体问题容易扫描；回答列保有较多空间，表头均未换行。","problems":"多条链接在域名或路径内部被拆开，留下很短的尾行，影响识别和使用。","cause":"链接列宽187px，扣除内边距后只有166px，小于最长连续字符串所需的175px。"},{"design":"r1B","good":"链接列足以避免词中拆分；回答列与r1A几乎同宽，行高未增加，问题、回答和链接的层次清楚。","problems":"问题列略窄，部分问题分成三行；带连字符的链接在连字符处换行，虽然完整性尚可，但视觉上不如整条显示直接。","cause":"问题列为115px；链接列为196px，恰好满足最长连续字符串的宽度，但不足以容纳最长链接的整行宽度。"},{"design":"r1C","good":"所有链接都保持单行，便于浏览和识别；问题列的扫描方式与r1B一致。","problems":"链接列留白较多，而回答更拥挤；部分回答多出一行，拉高对应行，整表的阅读节奏变长。","cause":"链接列增至213px，挤占回答列至209px；减少的回答宽度使部分文字跨过换行阈值。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"平衡链接","widths":[115,216,206],"change":"在r1B基础上给链接列增加10px，尝试让更多链接保持单行，同时观察回答减少10px后是否仍能维持较好的行高。"},{"name":"宽问题列","widths":[125,216,196],"change":"保留r1B中避免链接词中拆分的最低链接宽度，把10px转给问题列，改善问题扫描，并检验回答宽度减少后的代价。"},{"name":"宽回答列","widths":[105,236,196],"change":"保留196px链接列，将问题列缩窄10px并转给回答列，探索更宽回答能否改善长段落及行高，同时检查问题是否仍易扫描。"}]}
